patterns: What is the development process for Website?
development process for Website
responses:
Our website development process generally includes:
- Requirement Gathering — understanding your business, goals, features, and target audience.
- Planning — defining the technology stack, architecture, integrations, and project scope.
- UI/UX Design — creating the website structure, user experience, and visual design.
- Development — building the frontend, backend, database, APIs, and required integrations.
- Quality Assurance — testing functionality, responsiveness, performance, compatibility, and security.
- Deployment — launching the website on the production environment.
- Post-launch Support — providing maintenance, updates, and ongoing improvements.

patterns: quotation for Web App development

cost for Web App
estimate for Web App
responses:
Absolutely. We can help you with a quotation for your web application.
To provide a more accurate estimate, please share:
- Brief description of the web app
- Required features/modules
- User types and expected number of users
- Any required third-party integrations
- Preferred technology, if any
- Whether UI/UX design is required
- Expected timeline
You can also share an existing website, app, document, or feature list if you have one. Based on these details, our team can review the requirements and provide a suitable estimate.
